name: Landcare Action Grants (Landcare Tasmania)
summary: Devolved Tasmanian Government grants, delivered by Landcare Tasmania to its members, for on-ground work such as weed control, fencing and invasive species management on high conservation value land and waterways.

amount.note: Up to $40,000 for exceptional projects, as judged by the assessment panel

reporting: Progress report due October-November 2026; final report and financial acquittal due April 2027

eligibility.rule: Be a member of Landcare Tasmania
Hold membership for the organisation when applying on its behalf
Has acquitted all funds from earlier projects
Project protects, enhances or maintains high conservation value areas

documents: Contractor quote(s), based on contractor fees
Materials quote, if materials cost more than $2,500
Relevant permits or approvals, where applicable
Site photos showing the natural values

status.quote: Apply now: Applications are now closed.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include all types of Landcare Tasmania members: Community Care Group* Individual Associate (farm, school, business, aboriginal organisation, club or association, trust, government entity)**

geography.quote: Landcare Action Grants 2026: Protecting, Enhancing, and Maintaining Tasmania's Natural Values

access.quote: To be eligible to apply for the grant, you must be a member of Landcare Tasmania.

window.quote: applications open 2nd December 2025 Applications close 31st Jan 2026

amount.quote: The preferred project funding amount is $5,000 to $20,000 (ex. GST) per project, with up to $40,000 (ex. GST) available for exceptional projects as determined by the assessment panel.

administered_by.quote: Landcare Tasmania has been a major delivery partner of the Landcare Action Grants with the Tasmanian Government since 2018.

reporting.quote: Progress report October - November 2026 Project works completion date April 2027 Final report and financial acquittal due April 2027

eligibility.quote: To be eligible to apply for the grant, you must be a member of Landcare Tasmania.
then you must hold a membership for that organisation as an Associate member.
The applicant has acquitted all funds from other projects.
The project addresses the grant theme of protecting, enhancing, or maintaining High Conservation Value areas.

after_award.quote: Final report and financial acquittal due April 2027

documents.quote: Map of project location (image of Google maps, JPEG/PDF or LISTmap bookmark) 2. A minimum of one contractor quote if contractor fees will be less than $2,500 or minimum of two contractor quotes if contractor fees will be greater than $2,500 3. At least one quote for materials, if materials cost more than $2,500.

Existing management plans, where applicable (e.g. conservation management agreement or property management plan) 5. Letter of consent from the relevant landholder/s, where applicable 6. Insurance certificate 7. Relevant permits and/or approvals to carry out the potential work, where applicable
Letters of support from project Partners, where applicable
images are a requirement to assess the condition of the project's natural values
